edges.relationship: automotive ASIC design-development services (multi-year, repeatedly upsized contract)

contracts.signal: AD Technology half-year report section XI (2026-06-30) lists the BOS Semiconductor automotive ASIC design contract: signed 2023-09-15 at KRW 22.1B, amended to KRW 22.1B on 2024-10-02, KRW 31.7B on 2025-06-26, KRW 31.4B on 2025-10-15, end date moved to 2026-08-21 on 2026-01-23, and amended again on 2026-06-30 (contract date, amount and payment terms). Contract total now KRW 35,203M, term 2023-09-15 to 2027-02-28; KRW 3,095M recognised in H1 2026 (KRW 29,458M cumulative) and KRW 2,577M collected in H1 (KRW 19,589M cumulative). Automotive design services were 7.31% (KRW 5,995M) of H1 2026 consolidated revenue.

AD Technology half-year report section XI (2026-06-30) lists a custom ASIC design contract with Siemens Industry Software Inc.: signed 2023-08-31, amended 2025-12-08 (disclosed 12-09-2025), completion date 2026-11-30, in progress at the filing date. Contract value is not disclosed at the customer's request (priced in USD and KRW); this corresponds to custom-IC development contract B in the notes, 93.00% complete at 2026-06-30 with KRW 1,262M of contract liabilities outstanding.

edges.relationship: Arm Total Design partner - Neoverse CSS CPU IP licensed into AD Technology HPC/AI SoC platforms

contracts.signal: AD Technology half-year report: Arm Approved Design Partner since 2020-12 and Arm Total Design Partner since 2023-10; R&D pipeline builds the Neoverse N2-based ADP-600 HPC platform (2025-01 to 2026-12) and the Neoverse V3-based ADP620 platform on Samsung 2nm with CXL 3.0 / PCIe Gen6 / UCIe (2024-11 to 2028-07). Imported IP purchases reached KRW 25,674M (USD 17,303K) in H1 2026 versus KRW 42,898M for all of FY2025; the filing does not split the Arm share.
